content: नन्दा [नन्दयति नन्द्-अच्] .²1 Delight, joy, happiness. .²2 Affluence, wealth, prosperity. .²3 A small earthen water-jar. .²4 A husbandʼs sister. .²5 The first, sixth and eleventh days of a lunar fortnight (considered as auspicious {%tithis%}); नन्दा भद्रा जया रिक्ता पूर्णा च प्रतिपत् क्रमात् <ls>Jyotistattvam.</ls> .²6 An epithet of Gaurī. .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of a cave; नन्दागुहायामिव नागराजः <ls>Bu. Ch. 1. 19</ls>.
